title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I'm from India but currently residing in Sharjah, U.A.E. in a rented accommodation. Before going to India for a vacation of two months, my neighbours requested our flat for the stay of their guests during our absence. They said that their guests shall pay the rent to me for their stay & settle other bills like electricity, etc. I took some advance amount before going to India and handed-over the possesion of my flat to their guests. After coming back from vacation & taking back the possession of my flat, I got a doubt whether I had done the right act. I checked my tenancy contract and found a condition that says "Tenant has no right to waive or sublease property for investment, unless authorized by the Department of Economic Development in the emirate and with a written approval of the lessor (i.e. owner)". Kindly let me know whether I have violated the above condition. I would like to know the following: a) Whether the amount received from my neighbours' guests would be halal? b) If not halal, what should I do with the money? should I give it in Charity or should I give it back to the concerned person after dedcuting the repair charges, etc.? c) If I could not find the person from whom I received the rent amount or if the person refuses to take back the amount, what should I do? Anticipating your reply as soon as possible. 1910 views Q. We are running a 5 star hotel with bar which is against sharia. We need following clarification as per quran and sharia. 1. If we give bar area to outside the company o rent which is permissiable in sharia. 2. If we lease out the hotel completly with bar and will get yearly rent of a prperty. Wat will sharia says can we still commiting sin as per quran. 3.what is the solution for us in order to follow islamic principles to avoid bar permisses. 4.if a person is not taking any bar income but the place in hotel is run by the other partner what islamic sharia says . Please through light in the matter. 1876 views Q. I have a question about loan that I have given 40 Omani Riyals to my friend as loan before six months 1749 views Q. If some one give gold to other as loan on the terms that when the other return he will return the same quantity of gold, Is this deal is permissibl? 2159 views Q. Assalamu alaikum I hv a brother. We both are married and having sons. We were living with our uncles after my father's death (my mother's brother) and working under them for the past 15 to 20yrs. Due to misunderstanding our uncles gave our part of inheritance, we were forced to leave ours uncles company. We started our own business but unfortunately it's not doing well. In the mean time we don't have own house and we are still leaving in our uncles flat. We are not comfortable leaving there after coming out. If we want to buy a flat we don't have money to purchase, in the above context please advise whether we can get loan from bank to buy a house or flat. Based on your fatwa we wl do accordingly. 1693 views Q. I am getting a house on heavy deposit. Heavy deposit means giving one big amount to the owner of the flat till the duration of the contract 27618 views Q. We have Islamic Bank here in UAE Providing Loan for Purchasing the Car, If we intersted in one car(Whether new or second hand) we should go to the bank with the seller(if new the dealer details and qutation from the dealer), then the bank will purchase the car from the seller or dealer and will sell to us with a certain profit, and the total amount(original price the profit taken by the bank) can be paid in installments. may i know this loan is islamic??(As the bank is not a car dealer or an auto dealer) Working in such an islamic bank is halaal?, particularly on this section. 2137 views Q. In my business I have to buy materials from suppliers . They take a 3-5% commission for there help in getting the materials to me. As they are using their contacts and goodwill to procure materials for me. In fact they are taking this amount from the raw material manufacturer as the amount is added into my price. Can I buy the materials from the suppliers without doing a GUNAAH in the light of the SHARIAT ? WILL MY EARNED MONEY BE HALAL ! If it is GUNAAH in the light of SHARIAH then I will have to buy the material direct from the manufacturer , but will it not amount to BREACH OF TRUST ON MY PART BECAUSE THESE SUPPLIERS HAVE HELPED ME ESTABLISH MY BUSINESS and Now when I leave them ( because I can now finance my business without their help ) will it not be wrong on my PART IN THE LIGHT OF THE SHARIAT ? Jazak ALLAH O KHAIR for helping me. 1646 views Q. I have rented a part of a building from mr. azharuddin in 1996 according to aggreement we were increasing the rent by 10%every year. then in 2001 he sold the building to dr. nusrat. we did make any aggreement with dr. nusrat ,however we regularly paid the rent without any increase. in 2010 dr,nusrat sold it back to mr. azharuddin. now mr. azharuddin is demanding 10%increase for each year for 10 years as arreas. AM I REQUIRED TO PAY THE ARREAS AS DEMANDE BY MR. AZHARUDDIN? 1794 views Q. Salam, my uncle runs a business and he wants some investments to be made by relatives alone, i want to get my friends money and invest it.The investment will yield some profit for my friend, the question is, can i get a percentage of the profit as commission? For example My friend invests rs.1 lakh and the profit for a month is say rs.4000/- i will give him rs.2500/- rest i will take. is this kind of commission allowed 1713 views Q. Hamid wants to build a house in June 2012. Now in October 2011, the cement price is 250 per packet (50 kg). 1435 views Q. I want to puchase a car on bank loan. Whether it is jaeez?if yes in what ways? if no what is the way to puchase a car saving my skin from the lanat of interest? please find the way. 2380 views Q. loan from bank 4365 views Q. A person doing welding work at my house had left his welding machine of his own will in my garage for a month as there was work left and raw material was not available. Even though I told him to take his machine back with him, he did not take it since he had other machines. Unfortunately it was stolen from my house. The machine was costly. In the light of shari'a, am I liable to compensate him? Jazakallah Khair. 1521 views Q. Please, say about the store or stock of Grain is right or not? Please, say about that business jaiz or najaiz? 1883 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 7169 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can I work in an environment where gambling is practiced, but I don't work in the gambling industry but merely provide security for the general public. The event is based on horses racing and competing with each other and the horse that wins the race gets prize money. But, the people are gambling on each horse. Sheikh Makhtom of Dubai also has horses competing. Is this Haram or Halal earning? Question: Can I work in an environment where gambling is practiced, but I don't work in the gambling industry but merely provide security for the general public. The event is based on horses racing and competing with each other and the horse that wins the race gets prize money. But, the people are gambling on each horse. Sheikh Makhtom of Dubai also has horses competing. Is this Haram or Halal earning? Answer ID: 7169 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1036/919=L/1429) The work you do is permissible and the income is halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
